title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Integrated Nutrition, Health and Food Security and Livelihood programme is implemented by Trócaire in Tobo, Heiban and Dellami counties, aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective include, conduct participatory market & livelihood assessment, train and support women and youth in business/livelihood skills, support formation and access to VSLA plus start up supports. So, people living in poverty, particularly rural women and youth, experience sustainable economic well-being and have control over resources. Programmes are in partnership with, KAMMA organization for Development Initiatives.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2.1Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:- The sustainable economic well-being of people, especially women and youth, via market systems development initiatives- Where possible, income generating initiatives will include an agroecology lensCapacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
